derivation: exact hm.map_of_surjective_of_ker_le Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (by simpa using hK)
explanation: Mathlib proves maximality of the image of a maximal ideal under any surjective ring homomorphism whose kernel is contained in that ideal. Instantiate the homomorphism with the quotient map; its kernel is K, so hK supplies the kernel condition. The current proof instead uses the surjective-map disjunction and a local helper.
